_comment: The §64 model registry. Every prediction stores which version made it,
so a field can always be traced to what produced it.
scripts/seed_demo.py loads THIS file into the model_versions table; it keeps no copy.
§69: describe only what runs. `provider` must name an implementation that exists;
tests/ai/test_model_registry.py fails if it names one that does not.
An earlier version listed PP-Structure, LayoutLMv3 and IndicBERT here. None of them

versions.name: ocr-v1
versions.description: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 with lang='hi' (the Devanagari recognition model, which also reads Latin letters and digits). Gemini vision is registered as a fallback and marks its output degraded.
versions.notes: Pretrained, not fine-tuned. §66: measure before training.

versions.name: layout-v1
versions.description: Deterministic geometry, not a model: table rows are detected from OCR box positions, and each extracted field gets a fixed layout-evidence score for how its value was located (value right of label 0.90, table column 0.85, beside the area 0.80, below the label 0.78, inline 0.62).
versions.notes: Deterministic table geometry runs in production. Optional region-model experiments are documented separately in docs/ai-pipeline.md.

versions.name: extractor-v1
versions.description: Deterministic rules over OCR blocks: fuzzy label matching, then value-right, inline and value-below strategies, plus table-column extraction. Values that cannot be normalised are dropped and reported missing.
versions.notes: Rules first: each value records which strategy found it. Unsuccessful model experiments are documented separately in docs/ai-pipeline.md.

versions.name: confidence-v1
versions.description: Weighted fusion of OCR 0.40, extraction 0.25, layout 0.15, validation 0.15 and language 0.05, renormalised over the signals present.
versions.notes: Not calibrated. ECE and reliability diagrams are §65 work not yet done.

versions.name: anomaly-v1
versions.description: Deterministic history rules, plus a scikit-learn Isolation Forest over 10 parcel features.
versions.notes: The forest is fitted on the corpus at analysis time, not shipped as a checkpoint. With fewer than 30 parcels, or without scikit-learn, only the rules run.

versions.name: handwriting-v1
versions.description: Untrained geometry heuristic on OCR line crops flags suspected handwriting and requires review. False means not detected, not confirmed printed.
versions.notes: Synthetic-font development measurements only; low recall, no real-handwriting accuracy claim. No dedicated handwriting reader. See docs/handwriting-audit.md.
